Flight VV30 lifted off on 15 September at 03:21 (14 September at 22:21 local time). FLEX is designed to reveal a phenomenon invisible to the human eye: the faint fluorescence emitted by plants as they photosynthesise. Equipped with a Fluorescence Imaging Spectrometer, FLEX will detect and measure this incredibly weak signal from orbit. value.title: Germany to tighten eligibility rules for coal-to-gas projects in power auctions
value.snippet: Germany will tighten the eligibility rules governing conversion projects for existing coal-fired power plants to switch to gas in power capacity auctions, the economy ministry said on Tuesday. The ministry said it will introduce a regulation clarifying when a fuel switch at a coal-fired plant qualifies as a "new build" project and therefore counts towards minimum investment requirements.

value.title: Canada has not made a decision about lifting Arctic drilling ban, Carney says
value.snippet: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Tuesday that his government has not made a decision about lifting its decade-long moratorium on offshore oil and gas exploration in the Arctic, a move that some Northern leaders have advocated for as a way to increase the region's economic self-sufficiency. Last week's federal budget contained a reference to C$11-million ($7.79-million) in funding over four years to "support the governance and oversight of offshore oil and gas activities in the Arctic Ocean." Carney told reporters in Montreal the budget item represents "capacity funding" for Inuit leadership, with whom the federal government has agreed to jointly manage natural resources in the North.

value.title: US lenders do not plan to approve Kazakh mine deal backed by Trump's sons, US official says
value.snippet: US government lenders do not plan to approve $1.6-billion in financing for a Kazakh mining project once hailed as a key part of President Donald Trump's push to secure critical minerals supply chains, a US official and a source familiar with the matter said on Tuesday. Neither the US Export-Import Bank (EXIM) nor the US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) plans to fund the tungsten-mining venture, the officials said. They issued letters of interest in the project with Cove Kaz Capital Group last year.
